title: data table: auto column width is estimated from the raw value, so formatted currency truncates beside free space and the Progress percentage hides under the sticky Actions column
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — list views | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), items 10 (width) and 12. Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (the width estimate about `:1003`; `maxWidth` and `truncate` about `:2674` and `:2910`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the width is sized from the stored value, not from the rendered text.

## What happens

On Projects → All Projects, Budget shows "200,000…." with spare width in the row, and the same happens on the CRM Workbench. On Tasks at 1440 px, the Progress percentage (stored `0.45`) is clipped under the sticky Actions column.

## Done when

- Auto width is estimated from the formatted cell text: currency, percent and so on.
- A sticky column never covers a cell's content.
- **Pins:** the measured Budget and Progress cells render whole at 1440 px.
